strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.title: 唱筹量沙
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.subtitle: 檀道济
strings.vo.01: 元嘉七年，宋军北伐失利。次年正月，檀道济率军去救被北魏围困的滑台。
strings.vo.02: 他一路与魏军交战三十多次，多有胜利，可到了历城，粮草用尽，滑台也失守了，只能回师。
strings.vo.03: 军中有逃兵投降了魏军，把宋军缺粮的实情全说了出来。魏军随即追来，宋军人人惊惧。
strings.vo.04: 那天夜里，檀道济让士兵在营中高声唱着数目量米，量的其实是沙，再把仅剩的一点米撒在沙堆上面。
strings.vo.05: 天亮了，魏军的探子望见营中堆着的“粮食”——
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.quote: 道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.fork.prompt: 唱筹量沙——依《宋书》直书，还是听后世「三十六策，走是上计」？
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《宋书》《南史·檀道济传》与《资治通鉴》所载
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.canon.intro: 粮尽、兵疲、逃卒泄密，追兵在后。檀道济手里只剩下一样东西：魏军对他的忌惮。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.end.canon: 魏军以为宋军粮多，又疑有伏兵，不敢逼近，引兵退去。檀道济全军而返，威名更盛。五年后，宋文帝忌其功高，将他收捕处死。道济临刑脱帻投地，说：乃坏汝万里之长城！
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.pick.legend: 后世 · 三十六策，走是上计
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.legend.discla: 以下取《南齐书·王敬则传》所载“檀公三十六策，走是上计”，以及后世据此敷衍的兵书《三十六计》（明清时托名之作）；并参照蔡东藩《南北史演义》第十回、第十一回。这是后世的引申与演义。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.legend.intro: 几十年后，南齐的老将王敬则起兵，听说朝廷的人在议论他要逃，冷笑道：檀公三十六策，走是上计。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.changchou.end.legend: 走是上计，可檀道济最后没能走掉。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 南北朝 · 宋元嘉八年，北魏神䴥四年（431 年二月）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。
setting.en: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 431 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

characters.name: 檀道济
characters.zh: 檀道济（刘宋·征南大将军）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽，两裆铠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；北伐救滑台，粮尽，唱筹量沙全军而返
characters.en: Tan Daoji (檀道济) — general, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 降卒
characters.zh: 降卒（刘宋·宋军逃卒）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽，两裆铠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；投魏告以宋军粮尽
characters.en: Jiang Zu (降卒) — commoner, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 朱修之
characters.zh: 朱修之（刘宋·滑台守将）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽，两裆铠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；守滑台数月，粮尽城陷
characters.en: Zhu Xiuzhi (朱修之) — general, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 北魏追兵将领
characters.zh: 北魏追兵将领（北魏·魏将）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；见量沙之状，疑而不追
characters.en: Bei Weizhuibingjiangling (北魏追兵将领) — general, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 刘义隆
characters.zh: 刘义隆（刘宋·宋文帝）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；元嘉十三年杀檀道济
characters.en: Liu Yilong (刘义隆) — ruler, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 元嘉七年，宋军北伐失利。次年正月，檀道济率军去救被北魏围困的滑台。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–9 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、营帐｜动作：济水岸边，宋军连营｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「唱筹量沙」竖排书法与朱印「量沙」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元嘉七年，宋军北伐失利。次年正月，檀道济率军去救被北魏围困的滑台。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, army tents | Action: Song camps along the Ji River | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「唱筹量沙」 with vermilion seal 「量沙」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元嘉七年，宋军北伐失利。次年正月，檀道济率军去救被北魏围困的滑台。」

shots.vo: 他一路与魏军交战三十多次，多有胜利，可到了历城，粮草用尽，滑台也失守了，只能回师。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（9–19 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：营帐、沙；主体：檀道济｜动作：粮车空了，士兵把最后的米倒进斗里｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；干笔擦出沙地｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：倒粮｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他一路与魏军交战三十多次，多有胜利，可到了历城，粮草用尽，滑台也失守了，只能回师。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (9–19 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents, sand; subject: Tan Daoji | Action: The grain carts are empty; soldiers pour the last rice into the measure | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: pouring grain | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他一路与魏军交战三十多次，多有胜利，可到了历城，粮草用尽，滑台也失守了，只能回师。」

shots.vo: 军中有逃兵投降了魏军，把宋军缺粮的实情全说了出来。魏军随即追来，宋军人人惊惧。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（19–29 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：月；中景：草；主体：降卒｜动作：一个逃卒趁夜奔向魏营｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：引文「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「军中有逃兵投降了魏军，把宋军缺粮的实情全说了出来。魏军随即追来，宋军人人惊惧。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (19–29 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: grass; subject: Jiang Zu | Action: A deserter runs to the Wei camp at night | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「军中有逃兵投降了魏军，把宋军缺粮的实情全说了出来。魏军随即追来，宋军人人惊惧。」

shots.vo: 那天夜里，檀道济让士兵在营中高声唱着数目量米，量的其实是沙，再把仅剩的一点米撒在沙堆上面。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（29–41 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐、沙；主体：檀道济、火｜动作：营中火把通明，有人高声唱筹，量的是沙｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：诵经｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「那天夜里，檀道济让士兵在营中高声唱着数目量米，量的其实是沙，再把仅剩的一点米撒在沙堆上面。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (29–41 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents, sand; subject: Tan Daoji, fire (splashed ink) | Action: Torches blaze; someone calls out the measures, but it is sand | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: chanting | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「那天夜里，檀道济让士兵在营中高声唱着数目量米，量的其实是沙，再把仅剩的一点米撒在沙堆上面。」

shots.vo: 天亮了，魏军的探子望见营中堆着的“粮食”——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（41–47 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：军阵、长兵如林、旌旗；飞白题字「徐出」｜动作：天亮，宋军披甲列阵，缓缓出营｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「天亮了，魏军的探子望见营中堆着的“粮食”——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (41–47 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: army ranks, forest of spears, banners; dry-brush calligraphy 「徐出」 | Action: At dawn the Song army marches out slowly in full armour | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「天亮了，魏军的探子望见营中堆着的“粮食”——」

shots.vo: 魏军以为宋军粮多，又疑有伏兵，不敢逼近，引兵退去。檀道济全军而返，威名更盛。五年后，宋文帝忌其功高，将他收捕处死。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（47–60 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：魏军以为宋军粮多，又疑有伏兵，不敢逼近，引兵退去。檀道济全军而返，威名更盛。五年后，宋文帝忌其功高，将他收捕处死。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「魏军以为宋军粮多，又疑有伏兵，不敢逼近，引兵退去。檀道济全军而返，威名更盛。五年后，宋文帝忌其功高，将他收捕处死。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (47–60 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Wei thinks the Song well supplied and fears an ambush; Tan Daoji returns intact, but is later executed: you destroy your own Great Wall! | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「魏军以为宋军粮多，又疑有伏兵，不敢逼近，引兵退去。檀道济全军而返，威名更盛。五年后，宋文帝忌其功高，将他收捕处死。」

shots.vo: 道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（60–66 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」，下署《资治通鉴·卷一百二十二 宋纪四 元嘉八年》；右下角朱印「量沙」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (60–66 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」 signed 《资治通鉴·卷一百二十二 宋纪四 元嘉八年》; vermilion seal 「量沙」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：琵琶，铿锵急切或婉转低回，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、战后余风、夜风；音效：倒粮、脚步声、诵经、战鼓；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, lingering wind after battle, night wind; SFX: pouring grain, footsteps, chanting, war drums; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「唱筹量沙」、副题「檀道济」、朱印「量沙」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」——《资治通鉴·卷一百二十二 宋纪四 元嘉八年》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「唱筹量沙」, subtitle 「檀道济」 and vermilion seal 「量沙」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」 — 《资治通鉴·卷一百二十二 宋纪四 元嘉八年》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 元嘉七年，宋军北伐失利。次年正月，檀道济率军去救被北魏围困的滑台。
他一路与魏军交战三十多次，多有胜利，可到了历城，粮草用尽，滑台也失守了，只能回师。
军中有逃兵投降了魏军，把宋军缺粮的实情全说了出来。魏军随即追来，宋军人人惊惧。
那天夜里，檀道济让士兵在营中高声唱着数目量米，量的其实是沙，再把仅剩的一点米撒在沙堆上面。
天亮了，魏军的探子望见营中堆着的“粮食”——
魏军以为宋军粮多，又疑有伏兵，不敢逼近，引兵退去。檀道济全军而返，威名更盛。五年后，宋文帝忌其功高，将他收捕处死。
道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】南北朝 · 唱筹量沙（檀道济）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 66 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：南北朝 · 宋元嘉八年，北魏神䴥四年（431 年二月）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。

人物：
- 檀道济（刘宋·征南大将军）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽，两裆铠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；北伐救滑台，粮尽，唱筹量沙全军而返
- 降卒（刘宋·宋军逃卒）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽，两裆铠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；投魏告以宋军粮尽
- 朱修之（刘宋·滑台守将）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽，两裆铠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；守滑台数月，粮尽城陷
- 北魏追兵将领（北魏·魏将）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；见量沙之状，疑而不追
- 刘义隆（刘宋·宋文帝）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；元嘉十三年杀檀道济

分镜：
镜头 1（0–9 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、营帐｜动作：济水岸边，宋军连营｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「唱筹量沙」竖排书法与朱印「量沙」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元嘉七年，宋军北伐失利。次年正月，檀道济率军去救被北魏围困的滑台。」
镜头 2（9–19 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：营帐、沙；主体：檀道济｜动作：粮车空了，士兵把最后的米倒进斗里｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；干笔擦出沙地｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：倒粮｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他一路与魏军交战三十多次，多有胜利，可到了历城，粮草用尽，滑台也失守了，只能回师。」
镜头 3（19–29 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：月；中景：草；主体：降卒｜动作：一个逃卒趁夜奔向魏营｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：引文「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「军中有逃兵投降了魏军，把宋军缺粮的实情全说了出来。魏军随即追来，宋军人人惊惧。」
镜头 4（29–41 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐、沙；主体：檀道济、火｜动作：营中火把通明，有人高声唱筹，量的是沙｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：诵经｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「那天夜里，檀道济让士兵在营中高声唱着数目量米，量的其实是沙，再把仅剩的一点米撒在沙堆上面。」
镜头 5（41–47 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：军阵、长兵如林、旌旗；飞白题字「徐出」｜动作：天亮，宋军披甲列阵，缓缓出营｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「天亮了，魏军的探子望见营中堆着的“粮食”——」
镜头 6（47–60 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：魏军以为宋军粮多，又疑有伏兵，不敢逼近，引兵退去。檀道济全军而返，威名更盛。五年后，宋文帝忌其功高，将他收捕处死。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「魏军以为宋军粮多，又疑有伏兵，不敢逼近，引兵退去。檀道济全军而返，威名更盛。五年后，宋文帝忌其功高，将他收捕处死。」
镜头 7（60–66 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」，下署《资治通鉴·卷一百二十二 宋纪四 元嘉八年》；右下角朱印「量沙」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」

声音：背景乐：琵琶，铿锵急切或婉转低回，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、战后余风、夜风；音效：倒粮、脚步声、诵经、战鼓；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「唱筹量沙」、副题「檀道济」、朱印「量沙」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」——《资治通鉴·卷一百二十二 宋纪四 元嘉八年》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589) · Counting Sand as Grain: Tan Daoji (「唱筹量沙」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 66 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 431 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

Characters:
- Tan Daoji (檀道济) — general, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Jiang Zu (降卒) — commoner, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhu Xiuzhi (朱修之) — general, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Bei Weizhuibingjiangling (北魏追兵将领) — general, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Yilong (刘义隆) — ruler, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, army tents | Action: Song camps along the Ji River | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「唱筹量沙」 with vermilion seal 「量沙」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元嘉七年，宋军北伐失利。次年正月，檀道济率军去救被北魏围困的滑台。」
Shot 2 (9–19 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents, sand; subject: Tan Daoji | Action: The grain carts are empty; soldiers pour the last rice into the measure | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: pouring grain | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他一路与魏军交战三十多次，多有胜利，可到了历城，粮草用尽，滑台也失守了，只能回师。」
Shot 3 (19–29 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: grass; subject: Jiang Zu | Action: A deserter runs to the Wei camp at night | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「军中有逃兵投降了魏军，把宋军缺粮的实情全说了出来。魏军随即追来，宋军人人惊惧。」
Shot 4 (29–41 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents, sand; subject: Tan Daoji, fire (splashed ink) | Action: Torches blaze; someone calls out the measures, but it is sand | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: chanting | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「那天夜里，檀道济让士兵在营中高声唱着数目量米，量的其实是沙，再把仅剩的一点米撒在沙堆上面。」
Shot 5 (41–47 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: army ranks, forest of spears, banners; dry-brush calligraphy 「徐出」 | Action: At dawn the Song army marches out slowly in full armour | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「天亮了，魏军的探子望见营中堆着的“粮食”——」
Shot 6 (47–60 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Wei thinks the Song well supplied and fears an ambush; Tan Daoji returns intact, but is later executed: you destroy your own Great Wall! | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「魏军以为宋军粮多，又疑有伏兵，不敢逼近，引兵退去。檀道济全军而返，威名更盛。五年后，宋文帝忌其功高，将他收捕处死。」
Shot 7 (60–66 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」 signed 《资治通鉴·卷一百二十二 宋纪四 元嘉八年》; vermilion seal 「量沙」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」

Sound: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, lingering wind after battle, night wind; SFX: pouring grain, footsteps, chanting, war drums; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「唱筹量沙」, subtitle 「檀道济」 and vermilion seal 「量沙」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「道济夜唱筹量沙，以所余少米散其上。」 — 《资治通鉴·卷一百二十二 宋纪四 元嘉八年》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.title: 元嘉草草
strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.subtitle: 饮马长江
strings.vo.01: 元嘉之治，江南富庶。宋文帝想收复河南，王玄谟屡次进言北伐，文帝说：观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意。
strings.vo.02: 元嘉二十七年秋，宋军大举北伐。王玄谟围滑台，数月不下。
strings.vo.03: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军渡河来救，王玄谟大败而走。
strings.vo.04: 魏军长驱南下，一路直到长江北岸的瓜步，毁民屋编筏，声言要渡江。建康震恐。
strings.vo.05: 文帝登石头城北望，叹道——
strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.quote: 观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意
strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.fork.prompt: 元嘉草草——依《宋书》直书，还是听后世「赢得仓皇北顾」？
strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.canon.intro: 石头城上，宋文帝向北望去。江对岸的瓜步山上，魏军的营火连成一片。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.end.canon: 魏军攻盱眙不克，引兵北还。所过州郡赤地无余，春燕归，巢于林木。宋元嘉之治由此衰落。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.pick.legend: 后世 · 赢得仓皇北顾
strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.legend.disclaim: 以下是后世的诗与演义：南宋辛弃疾词以“元嘉草草”讽喻当时；蔡东藩《南北史演义》第十四、十五回铺陈了悬瓠、盱眙之战。对话为小说增饰。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.legend.intro: 七百多年后，辛弃疾登上京口北固亭，写道：元嘉草草，封狼居胥，赢得仓皇北顾。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.yuanjia.end.legend: 词写完了，元嘉的败局早已注定。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

characters.en: Chen Xian (陈宪) — general, Song; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 元嘉之治，江南富庶。宋文帝想收复河南，王玄谟屡次进言北伐，文帝说：观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–12 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、草｜动作：江淮之间，秋水｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水｜屏幕文字：片名「元嘉草草」竖排书法与朱印「仓皇北顾」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元嘉之治，江南富庶。宋文帝想收复河南，王玄谟屡次进言北伐，文帝说：观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–12 s, 12 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, grass | Action: Autumn waters between the Yangtze and the Huai | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「元嘉草草」 with vermilion seal 「仓皇北顾」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元嘉之治，江南富庶。宋文帝想收复河南，王玄谟屡次进言北伐，文帝说：观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意。」

shots.vo: 元嘉二十七年秋，宋军大举北伐。王玄谟围滑台，数月不下。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（12–20 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、卷轴；主体：宋文帝、王玄谟｜动作：文帝读玄谟所陈，有封狼居胥意｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元嘉二十七年秋，宋军大举北伐。王玄谟围滑台，数月不下。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (12–20 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, scroll; subject: Song Wendi, Wang Xuanmo | Action: Emperor Wen reads Wang Xuanmo's plans and dreams of Langjuxu | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元嘉二十七年秋，宋军大举北伐。王玄谟围滑台，数月不下。」

shots.vo: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军渡河来救，王玄谟大败而走。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（20–28 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；主体：军阵、长兵如林、盾墙｜动作：滑台城下，久攻不下｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：远处鼓声｜屏幕文字：引文「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军渡河来救，王玄谟大败而走。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (20–28 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: army ranks, forest of spears, shield wall | Action: Huatai resists all assaults | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; scorched-ink outline of battlements; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军渡河来救，王玄谟大败而走。」

shots.vo: 魏军长驱南下，一路直到长江北岸的瓜步，毁民屋编筏，声言要渡江。建康震恐。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（28–37 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：河水、烟；主体：骑兵｜动作：魏军渡河，玄谟败走｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；水墨流动晕染；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「魏军长驱南下，一路直到长江北岸的瓜步，毁民屋编筏，声言要渡江。建康震恐。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (28–37 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river, smoke; subject: cavalry | Action: Wei crosses the river and Wang Xuanmo flees | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; ink spatters where hooves strike; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「魏军长驱南下，一路直到长江北岸的瓜步，毁民屋编筏，声言要渡江。建康震恐。」

shots.vo: 文帝登石头城北望，叹道——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（37–43 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：近山与地面、河水；主体：拓跋焘；飞白题字「瓜步」｜动作：瓜步山上，魏帝望江｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：号角｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「文帝登石头城北望，叹道——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (37–43 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: near hills and ground, river; subject: Tuoba Dao; dry-brush calligraphy 「瓜步」 | Action: On Mount Guabu the Wei emperor gazes at the Yangtze | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「文帝登石头城北望，叹道——」

shots.vo: 魏军攻盱眙不克，引兵北还。所过州郡赤地无余，春燕归，巢于林木。宋元嘉之治由此衰落。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（43–53 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：拓跋焘｜动作：正史结局：魏军攻盱眙不克，引兵北还。所过州郡赤地无余，春燕归，巢于林木。宋元嘉之治由此衰落。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「魏军攻盱眙不克，引兵北还。所过州郡赤地无余，春燕归，巢于林木。宋元嘉之治由此衰落。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (43–53 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Tuoba Dao | Action: Canonical outcome: Wei fails at Xuyi and withdraws, leaving scorched land; swallows return to nest in trees, and the Yuanjia prosperity fades. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「魏军攻盱眙不克，引兵北还。所过州郡赤地无余，春燕归，巢于林木。宋元嘉之治由此衰落。」

shots.vo: 观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意
shots.zh: 镜头 7（53–59 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」，下署《宋书·王玄谟传》；右下角朱印「仓皇北顾」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」
shots.en: Shot 7 (53–59 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」 signed 《宋书·王玄谟传》; vermilion seal 「仓皇北顾」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」

sound.zh: 背景乐：笛子，清丽，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、宫殿回响、远处厮杀声、草原风；音效：竹简翻动、远处鼓声、马蹄声、号角；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: dizi flute, clear and lyrical, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, palace hall reverb, distant battle, steppe wind; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, distant drums, hoofbeats, horn; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「元嘉草草」、副题「饮马长江」、朱印「仓皇北顾」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」——《宋书·王玄谟传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「元嘉草草」, subtitle 「饮马长江」 and vermilion seal 「仓皇北顾」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」 — 《宋书·王玄谟传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 元嘉之治，江南富庶。宋文帝想收复河南，王玄谟屡次进言北伐，文帝说：观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意。
元嘉二十七年秋，宋军大举北伐。王玄谟围滑台，数月不下。
北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军渡河来救，王玄谟大败而走。
魏军长驱南下，一路直到长江北岸的瓜步，毁民屋编筏，声言要渡江。建康震恐。
文帝登石头城北望，叹道——
魏军攻盱眙不克，引兵北还。所过州郡赤地无余，春燕归，巢于林木。宋元嘉之治由此衰落。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】南北朝 · 元嘉草草（饮马长江）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 59 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：南北朝 · 宋元嘉二十七年至二十八年（450—451 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。

人物：
- 宋文帝（宋·刘义隆）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；锐意北伐，元嘉二十七年大举出兵
- 王玄谟（宋·宁朔将军）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽，两裆铠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；好言兵事，围滑台不下，败走
- 拓跋焘（北魏·北魏太武帝）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；亲率大军南下，至瓜步，饮马长江
- 臧质（宋·辅国将军）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽，两裆铠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；守盱眙，拒魏军
- 陈宪（宋·汝南太守行事）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽，两裆铠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；守悬瓠四十余日

分镜：
镜头 1（0–12 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、草｜动作：江淮之间，秋水｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水｜屏幕文字：片名「元嘉草草」竖排书法与朱印「仓皇北顾」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元嘉之治，江南富庶。宋文帝想收复河南，王玄谟屡次进言北伐，文帝说：观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意。」
镜头 2（12–20 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、卷轴；主体：宋文帝、王玄谟｜动作：文帝读玄谟所陈，有封狼居胥意｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元嘉二十七年秋，宋军大举北伐。王玄谟围滑台，数月不下。」
镜头 3（20–28 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；主体：军阵、长兵如林、盾墙｜动作：滑台城下，久攻不下｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：远处鼓声｜屏幕文字：引文「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军渡河来救，王玄谟大败而走。」
镜头 4（28–37 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：河水、烟；主体：骑兵｜动作：魏军渡河，玄谟败走｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；水墨流动晕染；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「魏军长驱南下，一路直到长江北岸的瓜步，毁民屋编筏，声言要渡江。建康震恐。」
镜头 5（37–43 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：近山与地面、河水；主体：拓跋焘；飞白题字「瓜步」｜动作：瓜步山上，魏帝望江｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：号角｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「文帝登石头城北望，叹道——」
镜头 6（43–53 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：拓跋焘｜动作：正史结局：魏军攻盱眙不克，引兵北还。所过州郡赤地无余，春燕归，巢于林木。宋元嘉之治由此衰落。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「魏军攻盱眙不克，引兵北还。所过州郡赤地无余，春燕归，巢于林木。宋元嘉之治由此衰落。」
镜头 7（53–59 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」，下署《宋书·王玄谟传》；右下角朱印「仓皇北顾」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」

声音：背景乐：笛子，清丽，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、宫殿回响、远处厮杀声、草原风；音效：竹简翻动、远处鼓声、马蹄声、号角；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「元嘉草草」、副题「饮马长江」、朱印「仓皇北顾」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」——《宋书·王玄谟传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589) · The Hasty Yuanjia Campaign (「元嘉草草」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 59 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 450 CE–451 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

Characters:
- Song Wendi (宋文帝) — ruler, Song; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wang Xuanmo (王玄谟) — general, Song; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Tuoba Dao (拓跋焘) — ruler, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zang Zhi (臧质) — general, Song; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Chen Xian (陈宪) — general, Song; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes; Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods, liangdang armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–12 s, 12 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, grass | Action: Autumn waters between the Yangtze and the Huai | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「元嘉草草」 with vermilion seal 「仓皇北顾」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元嘉之治，江南富庶。宋文帝想收复河南，王玄谟屡次进言北伐，文帝说：观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意。」
Shot 2 (12–20 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, scroll; subject: Song Wendi, Wang Xuanmo | Action: Emperor Wen reads Wang Xuanmo's plans and dreams of Langjuxu | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元嘉二十七年秋，宋军大举北伐。王玄谟围滑台，数月不下。」
Shot 3 (20–28 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: army ranks, forest of spears, shield wall | Action: Huatai resists all assaults | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; scorched-ink outline of battlements; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北魏太武帝拓跋焘亲率大军渡河来救，王玄谟大败而走。」
Shot 4 (28–37 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river, smoke; subject: cavalry | Action: Wei crosses the river and Wang Xuanmo flees | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; ink spatters where hooves strike; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「魏军长驱南下，一路直到长江北岸的瓜步，毁民屋编筏，声言要渡江。建康震恐。」
Shot 5 (37–43 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: near hills and ground, river; subject: Tuoba Dao; dry-brush calligraphy 「瓜步」 | Action: On Mount Guabu the Wei emperor gazes at the Yangtze | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「文帝登石头城北望，叹道——」
Shot 6 (43–53 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Tuoba Dao | Action: Canonical outcome: Wei fails at Xuyi and withdraws, leaving scorched land; swallows return to nest in trees, and the Yuanjia prosperity fades. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「魏军攻盱眙不克，引兵北还。所过州郡赤地无余，春燕归，巢于林木。宋元嘉之治由此衰落。」
Shot 7 (53–59 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」 signed 《宋书·王玄谟传》; vermilion seal 「仓皇北顾」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」

Sound: Music: dizi flute, clear and lyrical, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, palace hall reverb, distant battle, steppe wind; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, distant drums, hoofbeats, horn; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「元嘉草草」, subtitle 「饮马长江」 and vermilion seal 「仓皇北顾」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「观玄谟所陈，令人有封狼居胥意」 — 《宋书·王玄谟传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.title: 木兰辞
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.subtitle: 替父从军
strings.vo.01: 唧唧复唧唧，木兰当户织。不闻机杼声，惟闻女叹息。
strings.vo.02: 昨夜见军帖，可汗大点兵。军书十二卷，卷卷有爷名。
strings.vo.03: 阿爷无大儿，木兰无长兄。愿为市鞍马，从此替爷征。
strings.vo.04: 旦辞爷娘去，暮宿黄河边。不闻爷娘唤女声，但闻黄河流水鸣溅溅。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.quote: 雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离；双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.fork.prompt: 木兰辞——依《乐府诗集》直书，还是听后世「花木兰」？
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.pick.canon: 乐府 · 《木兰诗》所述（文学作品，非史实）
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.canon.intro: 夜里，织机停了。木兰手里拿着那卷军帖，上面写着父亲的名字。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.end.canon: 开我东阁门，坐我西阁床。当窗理云鬓，对镜帖花黄。出门看火伴，火伴皆惊忙：同行十二年，不知木兰是女郎。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.legend.disclaimer: 《木兰诗》没有说木兰姓什么。明代徐渭杂剧《雌木兰替父从军》（《四声猿》之一）始称她姓花，此后“花木兰”之名流传至今。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.legend.intro: 明人徐渭在杂剧里写：木兰姓花，父亲叫花弧。她换上男装，从军十二年。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.end.legend: 戏台上的花木兰与诗中的木兰合而为一。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.mulan.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若木兰受尚书郎（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

shots.en: Shot 1 (0–7 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy, gate; subject: Mu Lan | Action: Click-clack, Mulan weaves at the door | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: village ambience | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「木兰辞」 with vermilion seal 「木兰从军」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「唧唧复唧唧，木兰当户织。不闻机杼声，惟闻女叹息。」

shots.vo: 昨夜见军帖，可汗大点兵。军书十二卷，卷卷有爷名。

narration: 唧唧复唧唧，木兰当户织。不闻机杼声，惟闻女叹息。
昨夜见军帖，可汗大点兵。军书十二卷，卷卷有爷名。
阿爷无大儿，木兰无长兄。愿为市鞍马，从此替爷征。
旦辞爷娘去，暮宿黄河边。不闻爷娘唤女声，但闻黄河流水鸣溅溅。
万里赴戎机——
开我东阁门，坐我西阁床。当窗理云鬓，对镜帖花黄。出门看火伴，火伴皆惊忙：同行十二年，不知木兰是女郎。

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：村落人声、人群低语、平缓河水、草原风；音效：竹简翻动、马蹄声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「木兰辞」、副题「替父从军」、朱印「木兰从军」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离；双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌」——《乐府诗集·木兰诗》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589) · The Ballad of Mulan (「木兰辞」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 53 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), c. 450 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

Characters:
- Mu Lan (木兰) — commoner, Beichao; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Mu Lanzhifu (木兰之父) — commoner, Beichao; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Tian Zi (天子) — ruler, Beichao; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Huo Ban (火伴) — commoner, Beichao; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–7 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy, gate; subject: Mu Lan | Action: Click-clack, Mulan weaves at the door | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: village ambience | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「木兰辞」 with vermilion seal 「木兰从军」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「唧唧复唧唧，木兰当户织。不闻机杼声，惟闻女叹息。」
Shot 2 (7–14 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: scroll, 军帖; subject: Mu Lanzhifu | Action: Twelve scrolls of conscription, each with her father's name | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: village ambience; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「昨夜见军帖，可汗大点兵。军书十二卷，卷卷有爷名。」
Shot 3 (14–21 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: war horse, crowd | Action: A horse from the east market, a saddle from the west | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离；双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「阿爷无大儿，木兰无长兄。愿为市鞍马，从此替爷征。」
Shot 4 (21–29 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: river; subject: war horse | Action: Leaving at dawn, camping by the Yellow River at dusk | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; moon left blank with pale wash around it; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「旦辞爷娘去，暮宿黄河边。不闻爷娘唤女声，但闻黄河流水鸣溅溅。」
Shot 5 (29–35 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: cavalry; dry-brush calligraphy 「关山」 | Action: Ten thousand li to war, flying over passes and mountains | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; ink spatters where hooves strike; vignette closing in from the corners; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「万里赴戎机——」
Shot 6 (35–47 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Home at last, she dresses her hair at the window; her comrades are amazed—twelve years together and they never knew Mulan was a woman. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「开我东阁门，坐我西阁床。当窗理云鬓，对镜帖花黄。出门看火伴，火伴皆惊忙：同行十二年，不知木兰是女郎。」
Shot 7 (47–53 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离；双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌」 signed 《乐府诗集·木兰诗》; vermilion seal 「木兰从军」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离；双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌」

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: village ambience, crowd murmur, calm river, steppe wind; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, hoofbeats; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「木兰辞」, subtitle 「替父从军」 and vermilion seal 「木兰从军」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离；双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌」 — 《乐府诗集·木兰诗》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.title: 国史之狱
strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.subtitle: 崔浩
strings.vo.01: 北魏太武帝统一北方后，命司徒崔浩主持编修国史，嘱咐他务从实录。崔浩出身清河崔氏，是太武帝最倚重的汉人谋臣，曾劝太武帝废佛。
strings.vo.02: 崔浩与高允等人编成国书，把拓跋氏祖先的事迹，包括鲜卑人不愿提起的旧俗，都照实写了进去。
strings.vo.03: 有人建议把国史刻在石碑上，立在郊坛东边的大路旁，让过往的人都能看到。鲜卑贵族看了，纷纷向太武帝告状。
strings.vo.04: 太武帝大怒，下令追查。太子拓跋晃是高允的学生，教他见了皇帝就说，书都是崔浩写的。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.quote: 浩尽述国事，备而不典。而石铭显在衢路，往来行者咸以为言，事遂闻发。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.fork.prompt: 国史之狱——依《魏书》直书，还是听释家《广弘明集》？
strings.anchor.jianxiu: 太武帝命崔浩监秘书事，修国史
strings.anchor.zongai: 太武帝为宦官宗爱所弑
strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.canon.intro: 一个皇帝让臣子照实写下祖先的历史。书写成了，刻在了路边的石碑上，皇帝却要杀了写书的人。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.end.canon: 高允说，自己写的比崔浩还多，太子是可怜他才教他说谎。太武帝被他的直率打动，赦免了高允。崔浩被诛，清河崔氏不论远近，以及与崔氏联姻的范阳卢氏、太原郭氏、河东柳氏，都被灭族，秘书郎吏以下也都被处死。两年后，太武帝被宦官宗爱所杀。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.legend.disclaime: 以下取唐代僧人道宣《广弘明集》等佛教文献的说法：把崔浩之死说成是他劝太武帝毁佛的报应，太武帝晚年后悔，也是因为毁佛。属佛教护法文献的因果叙事，与《魏书》所记国史之狱的缘由不同。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.legend.intro: 广弘明集里说，崔浩劝太武帝焚毁佛寺、坑杀僧人，四年之后，自己也遭了大祸。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.end.legend: 太武帝死后，文成帝即位，下诏恢复佛法。几年后，平城西边的武州山开凿起了巨大的石窟，那就是云冈。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.cuihao.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若国史不刻石（未开放）

黑白红武侠水墨剪影素材图（人物立绘），题材：国史之狱·崔浩（450 年六月）。
画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：2×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 南北朝 · 北魏太武帝太平真君十一年（450 年六月）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。
setting.en: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 450 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

characters.name: 崔浩
characters.zh: 崔浩（北魏·司徒，监秘书事）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；主修国史，刻石立于衢路，坐此被诛
characters.en: Cui Hao (崔浩) — minister, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 北魏太武帝统一北方后，命司徒崔浩主持编修国史，嘱咐他务从实录。崔浩出身清河崔氏，是太武帝最倚重的汉人谋臣，曾劝太武帝废佛。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–15 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：拓跋焘、崔浩｜动作：平城的宫殿里，皇帝把修史的大权交给了一位白发的汉人谋臣｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：片名「国史之狱」竖排书法与朱印「国史」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「北魏太武帝统一北方后，命司徒崔浩主持编修国史，嘱咐他务从实录。崔浩出身清河崔氏，是太武帝最倚重的汉人谋臣，曾劝太武帝废佛。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–15 s, 15 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: Tuoba Dao, Cui Hao | Action: In the palace at Pingcheng the emperor hands charge of the history to a white-haired Han adviser | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「国史之狱」 with vermilion seal 「国史」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北魏太武帝统一北方后，命司徒崔浩主持编修国史，嘱咐他务从实录。崔浩出身清河崔氏，是太武帝最倚重的汉人谋臣，曾劝太武帝废佛。」

shots.vo: 崔浩与高允等人编成国书，把拓跋氏祖先的事迹，包括鲜卑人不愿提起的旧俗，都照实写了进去。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（15–26 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：高允、众人｜动作：秘书省里，几百个书吏一字一字地抄写拓跋氏的先世旧事｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「崔浩与高允等人编成国书，把拓跋氏祖先的事迹，包括鲜卑人不愿提起的旧俗，都照实写了进去。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (15–26 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Gao Yun, crowd | Action: In the archives hundreds of clerks copy out the old deeds of the Tuoba ancestors character by character | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「崔浩与高允等人编成国书，把拓跋氏祖先的事迹，包括鲜卑人不愿提起的旧俗，都照实写了进去。」

shots.vo: 有人建议把国史刻在石碑上，立在郊坛东边的大路旁，让过往的人都能看到。鲜卑贵族看了，纷纷向太武帝告状。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（26–38 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山；主体：盾墙、众人｜动作：郊坛东边的大路旁，一大片石碑林立，上面刻满了国史｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：凿石｜屏幕文字：引文「浩尽述国事，备而不典。而石铭显在衢路，往来行者咸以为言，事遂闻发。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「有人建议把国史刻在石碑上，立在郊坛东边的大路旁，让过往的人都能看到。鲜卑贵族看了，纷纷向太武帝告状。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (26–38 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; subject: shield wall, crowd | Action: Beside the road east of the suburban altar a forest of steles stands, carved with the state history | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: chiselling stone | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「浩尽述国事，备而不典。而石铭显在衢路，往来行者咸以为言，事遂闻发。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「有人建议把国史刻在石碑上，立在郊坛东边的大路旁，让过往的人都能看到。鲜卑贵族看了，纷纷向太武帝告状。」

shots.vo: 太武帝大怒，下令追查。太子拓跋晃是高允的学生，教他见了皇帝就说，书都是崔浩写的。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（38–48 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、关门；主体：拓跋晃、高允｜动作：宫门前，太子拉着老师的衣袖，叮嘱他见了皇帝该怎么说｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：低风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「太武帝大怒，下令追查。太子拓跋晃是高允的学生，教他见了皇帝就说，书都是崔浩写的。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (38–48 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, gate; subject: Tuoba Huang, Gao Yun | Action: At the palace gate the crown prince holds his teacher's sleeve and tells him what to say to the emperor | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「太武帝大怒，下令追查。太子拓跋晃是高允的学生，教他见了皇帝就说，书都是崔浩写的。」

narration: 北魏太武帝统一北方后，命司徒崔浩主持编修国史，嘱咐他务从实录。崔浩出身清河崔氏，是太武帝最倚重的汉人谋臣，曾劝太武帝废佛。
崔浩与高允等人编成国书，把拓跋氏祖先的事迹，包括鲜卑人不愿提起的旧俗，都照实写了进去。
有人建议把国史刻在石碑上，立在郊坛东边的大路旁，让过往的人都能看到。鲜卑贵族看了，纷纷向太武帝告状。
太武帝大怒，下令追查。太子拓跋晃是高允的学生，教他见了皇帝就说，书都是崔浩写的。
高允见了太武帝，却说——
高允说，自己写的比崔浩还多，太子是可怜他才教他说谎。太武帝被他的直率打动，赦免了高允。
浩尽述国事，备而不典。而石铭显在衢路，往来行者咸以为言，事遂闻发。

[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589) · The State History Case: Cui Hao (「国史之狱」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 71 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.title: 大明历
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.subtitle: 祖冲之
strings.vo.01: 祖冲之从小喜好天文历算。他发现当时通行的历法与实际天象已经差得很远。
strings.vo.02: 宋大明六年，他献上新编的《大明历》，第一次把岁差算进了历法，又改了闰法，三百九十一年中设一百四十四个闰月。
strings.vo.03: 权臣戴法兴上书反对，说古人定下的历法不能改，祖冲之是虚推妄改。祖冲之逐条反驳，说要以实测为凭。
strings.vo.04: 他还算出了圆周率在三点一四一五九二六与三点一四一五九二七之间，给出了密率三百五十五比一百一十三。
strings.vo.05: 孝武帝想颁行新历，可就在那时——
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.quote: 圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.fork.prompt: 大明历——依《宋书》直书，还是听后世「失传的《缀术》」？
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《南齐书·祖冲之传》《宋书·律历志》《隋书·律历志》所载
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.canon.intro: 祖冲之和戴法兴争的，不只是一部历法。一个说要信古人，一个说要信眼睛。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.end.canon: 孝武帝崩，新历未及颁行。直到梁天监九年，在其子祖暅之的力请下，《大明历》才正式施行。祖冲之造的指南车“圆转不穷而司方如一”，索驭驎的车颇有差僻，被毁而焚之。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.legend.discl: 以下取《隋书·律历志》对祖冲之《缀术》的记载：“学官莫能究其深奥，是故废而不理”，以及唐代国子监算学曾以《缀术》为教材的记载（《新唐书·选举志》），该书在北宋时失传。这是后世的流传史，书中内容今已无从得知。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.legend.intro: 祖冲之写过一部算书，叫《缀术》。唐朝的算学生要学四年才能读完。后来，它就不见了。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.end.legend: 书失传了，那两个数字留了下来：三百五十五，一百一十三。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.zuchongzhi.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若《大明历》当年颁行（未开放）

画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：4×4 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 远山（淡墨）；2. 近坡（中墨）；3. 土坡地线；4. 草丛（枯笔）。
第 2 行：5. 大江水面；6. 白色飞白浪花；7. 涟漪；8. 屋舍内景。
第 3 行：9. 竹简书卷；10. 灯烛；11. 案几；12. 星。
第 4 行：13. 沙；14. 殿柱；15. 屋檐；16. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：2048×2048 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 南北朝 · 宋大明六年（462 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。
setting.en: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 462 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

characters.name: 祖冲之
characters.zh: 祖冲之（刘宋·南徐州从事、娄县令）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；上《大明历》，算圆周率，造指南车、千里船
characters.en: Zu Chongzhi (祖冲之) — scholar, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 戴法兴
characters.zh: 戴法兴（刘宋·中书舍人）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；驳《大明历》，以为“虚推”
characters.en: Dai Faxing (戴法兴) — minister, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 索驭驎
characters.zh: 索驭驎（北方·北人）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；亦称能造指南车，与冲之对校而败
characters.en: Suo Yulin (索驭驎) — commoner, Beifang; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 刘骏
characters.zh: 刘骏（刘宋·宋孝武帝）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；欲行新历，未及而崩
characters.en: Liu Jun (刘骏) — ruler, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 祖冲之从小喜好天文历算。他发现当时通行的历法与实际天象已经差得很远。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：星；中景：筹；主体：祖冲之｜动作：夜空下，一根表杆，一卷竹筹｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；墨夜中留白点星｜声音：环境：夜风｜屏幕文字：片名「大明历」竖排书法与朱印「密率」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「祖冲之从小喜好天文历算。他发现当时通行的历法与实际天象已经差得很远。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: stars; midground: 筹; subject: Zu Chongzhi | Action: Under the night sky, a gnomon and a bundle of counting rods | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; stars as untouched dots in an ink night | Sound: ambience: night wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「大明历」 with vermilion seal 「密率」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「祖冲之从小喜好天文历算。他发现当时通行的历法与实际天象已经差得很远。」

shots.vo: 宋大明六年，他献上新编的《大明历》，第一次把岁差算进了历法，又改了闰法，三百九十一年中设一百四十四个闰月。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–23 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：沙、日影；主体：祖冲之｜动作：冬至前后，他一天天记下日影的长短｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；干笔擦出沙地｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋大明六年，他献上新编的《大明历》，第一次把岁差算进了历法，又改了闰法，三百九十一年中设一百四十四个闰月。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–23 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: sand, 日影; subject: Zu Chongzhi | Action: Around the winter solstice he records the shadow length day by day | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋大明六年，他献上新编的《大明历》，第一次把岁差算进了历法，又改了闰法，三百九十一年中设一百四十四个闰月。」

shots.vo: 权臣戴法兴上书反对，说古人定下的历法不能改，祖冲之是虚推妄改。祖冲之逐条反驳，说要以实测为凭。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（23–35 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：戴法兴｜动作：朝堂上，戴法兴拂袖而起｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：引文「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「权臣戴法兴上书反对，说古人定下的历法不能改，祖冲之是虚推妄改。祖冲之逐条反驳，说要以实测为凭。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (23–35 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Dai Faxing | Action: At court Dai Faxing rises angrily | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「权臣戴法兴上书反对，说古人定下的历法不能改，祖冲之是虚推妄改。祖冲之逐条反驳，说要以实测为凭。」

shots.vo: 他还算出了圆周率在三点一四一五九二六与三点一四一五九二七之间，给出了密率三百五十五比一百一十三。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（35–48 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：飞白题字「密率」｜动作：他在纸上把圆一次次切成更多的边｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：算盘｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他还算出了圆周率在三点一四一五九二六与三点一四一五九二七之间，给出了密率三百五十五比一百一十三。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (35–48 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: dry-brush calligraphy 「密率」 | Action: He divides the circle into more and more sides on paper | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: abacus | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他还算出了圆周率在三点一四一五九二六与三点一四一五九二七之间，给出了密率三百五十五比一百一十三。」

shots.vo: 孝武帝想颁行新历，可就在那时——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（48–54 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：索驭驎、祖冲之｜动作：乐游苑中，两辆指南车同时转向｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孝武帝想颁行新历，可就在那时——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (48–54 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Suo Yulin, Zu Chongzhi | Action: In the Leyou park two south-pointing carriages turn together | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孝武帝想颁行新历，可就在那时——」

shots.vo: 孝武帝崩，新历未及颁行。直到梁天监九年，在其子祖暅之的力请下，《大明历》才正式施行。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（54–65 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：索驭驎、祖冲之｜动作：正史结局：孝武帝崩，新历未及颁行。直到梁天监九年，在其子祖暅之的力请下，《大明历》才正式施行。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孝武帝崩，新历未及颁行。直到梁天监九年，在其子祖暅之的力请下，《大明历》才正式施行。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (54–65 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Suo Yulin, Zu Chongzhi | Action: Canonical outcome: The emperor dies before the calendar is adopted; it takes effect in 510 at his son's urging, and his south-pointing carriage outperforms its rival. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孝武帝崩，新历未及颁行。直到梁天监九年，在其子祖暅之的力请下，《大明历》才正式施行。」

shots.vo: 圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（65–71 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」，下署《隋书·律历志上》；右下角朱印「密率」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (65–71 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」 signed 《隋书·律历志上》; vermilion seal 「密率」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：夜风、旷野风声、宫殿回响、寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动、算盘、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: night wind, wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, abacus, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).
