narration: 祖冲之从小喜好天文历算。他发现当时通行的历法与实际天象已经差得很远。
宋大明六年，他献上新编的《大明历》，第一次把岁差算进了历法，又改了闰法，三百九十一年中设一百四十四个闰月。
权臣戴法兴上书反对，说古人定下的历法不能改，祖冲之是虚推妄改。祖冲之逐条反驳，说要以实测为凭。
他还算出了圆周率在三点一四一五九二六与三点一四一五九二七之间，给出了密率三百五十五比一百一十三。
孝武帝想颁行新历，可就在那时——
孝武帝崩，新历未及颁行。直到梁天监九年，在其子祖暅之的力请下，《大明历》才正式施行。
圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】南北朝 · 大明历（祖冲之）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 71 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：南北朝 · 宋大明六年（462 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。

人物：
- 祖冲之（刘宋·南徐州从事、娄县令）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；上《大明历》，算圆周率，造指南车、千里船
- 戴法兴（刘宋·中书舍人）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；驳《大明历》，以为“虚推”
- 索驭驎（北方·北人）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；亦称能造指南车，与冲之对校而败
- 刘骏（刘宋·宋孝武帝）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；欲行新历，未及而崩

分镜：
镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：星；中景：筹；主体：祖冲之｜动作：夜空下，一根表杆，一卷竹筹｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；墨夜中留白点星｜声音：环境：夜风｜屏幕文字：片名「大明历」竖排书法与朱印「密率」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「祖冲之从小喜好天文历算。他发现当时通行的历法与实际天象已经差得很远。」
镜头 2（10–23 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：沙、日影；主体：祖冲之｜动作：冬至前后，他一天天记下日影的长短｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；干笔擦出沙地｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋大明六年，他献上新编的《大明历》，第一次把岁差算进了历法，又改了闰法，三百九十一年中设一百四十四个闰月。」
镜头 3（23–35 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：戴法兴｜动作：朝堂上，戴法兴拂袖而起｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：引文「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「权臣戴法兴上书反对，说古人定下的历法不能改，祖冲之是虚推妄改。祖冲之逐条反驳，说要以实测为凭。」
镜头 4（35–48 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：飞白题字「密率」｜动作：他在纸上把圆一次次切成更多的边｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：算盘｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他还算出了圆周率在三点一四一五九二六与三点一四一五九二七之间，给出了密率三百五十五比一百一十三。」
镜头 5（48–54 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：索驭驎、祖冲之｜动作：乐游苑中，两辆指南车同时转向｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孝武帝想颁行新历，可就在那时——」
镜头 6（54–65 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：索驭驎、祖冲之｜动作：正史结局：孝武帝崩，新历未及颁行。直到梁天监九年，在其子祖暅之的力请下，《大明历》才正式施行。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孝武帝崩，新历未及颁行。直到梁天监九年，在其子祖暅之的力请下，《大明历》才正式施行。」
镜头 7（65–71 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」，下署《隋书·律历志上》；右下角朱印「密率」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589) · The Daming Calendar: Zu Chongzhi (「大明历」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 71 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 462 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

Characters:
- Zu Chongzhi (祖冲之) — scholar, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Dai Faxing (戴法兴) — minister, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Suo Yulin (索驭驎) — commoner, Beifang; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Jun (刘骏) — ruler, Liusong; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: stars; midground: 筹; subject: Zu Chongzhi | Action: Under the night sky, a gnomon and a bundle of counting rods | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; stars as untouched dots in an ink night | Sound: ambience: night wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「大明历」 with vermilion seal 「密率」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「祖冲之从小喜好天文历算。他发现当时通行的历法与实际天象已经差得很远。」
Shot 2 (10–23 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: sand, 日影; subject: Zu Chongzhi | Action: Around the winter solstice he records the shadow length day by day | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋大明六年，他献上新编的《大明历》，第一次把岁差算进了历法，又改了闰法，三百九十一年中设一百四十四个闰月。」
Shot 3 (23–35 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Dai Faxing | Action: At court Dai Faxing rises angrily | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「圆径一百一十三，圆周三百五十五。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「权臣戴法兴上书反对，说古人定下的历法不能改，祖冲之是虚推妄改。祖冲之逐条反驳，说要以实测为凭。」
Shot 4 (35–48 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: dry-brush calligraphy 「密率」 | Action: He divides the circle into more and more sides on paper | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: abacus | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他还算出了圆周率在三点一四一五九二六与三点一四一五九二七之间，给出了密率三百五十五比一百一十三。」
Shot 5 (48–54 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Suo Yulin, Zu Chongzhi | Action: In the Leyou park two south-pointing carriages turn together | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孝武帝想颁行新历，可就在那时——」

strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.title: 神灭论
strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.subtitle: 范缜
strings.vo.01: 南齐永明年间，竟陵王萧子良在建康鸡笼山开西邸，招集天下文士，萧衍、沈约、王融等都在其中。萧子良笃信佛法，常请名僧讲经。
strings.vo.02: 范缜也是西邸的宾客，却不信因果报应。萧子良问他：你不信因果，那世上为什么有富贵，有贫贱？
strings.vo.03: 范缜说：人生就像一棵树上的花，同时开放，随风飘落，有的拂过帘幕落在席上，有的撞到篱笆掉进了粪坑。落在席上的是殿下，落进粪坑的是下官。贵贱虽然不同，因果又在哪里呢？
strings.vo.04: 萧子良驳不倒他。王融去劝范缜：以你的才学，何愁当不上中书郎，何必固执此论？
strings.vo.05: 范缜大笑说：假如我范缜肯卖论取官，早就做到尚书令、仆射了，何止一个中书郎！他回去写了一篇文章——
strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.quote: 神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.fork.prompt: 神灭论——依《梁书》直书，还是听释家《弘明集》？
strings.anchor.xidi: 竟陵王萧子良开西邸，招集文士与名僧
strings.anchor.nannan: 梁武帝敕令王公朝贵六十余人作文驳难《神灭论》
strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.canon.intro: 一个人说，人死了，灵魂也就没了。为了让他改口，有人许他一个高官，他大笑着拒绝了。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.end.canon: 范缜在《神灭论》里说，形体与精神的关系，就像刀刃与锋利：没有刀刃就没有锋利，没有形体，哪里还有精神？萧衍即位成为梁武帝后，敕令王公朝贵六十多人写文章驳难，范缜仍不肯屈服。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.legend.disclaim: 以下取梁代僧祐所编《弘明集》：收录了梁武帝的敕书和曹思文、沈约等人驳难《神灭论》的文章，也收录了范缜的答辩。属佛教一方编集的论辩文献，立场鲜明。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.legend.intro: 弘明集里收着一道梁武帝的敕书，说范缜的文章违经背亲，应该让大臣们一起来驳斥。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.end.legend: 弘明集里，曹思文在驳难之后承认：我才思短浅，不能折服他的锋芒。佛教一方编集的书里，也保存下了对手的话。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.fanzhen.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若范缜卖论取官（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 南北朝 · 南齐武帝永明年间（约 489 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。
setting.en: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), c. 489 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

characters.name: 范缜
characters.zh: 范缜（南齐·尚书殿中郎）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；著《神灭论》，主张形神相即
characters.en: Fan Zhen (范缜) — scholar, Nanqi; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 萧子良
characters.zh: 萧子良（南齐·竟陵王）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；宗室贵胄华服，玉佩冠带；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；崇信佛法，与范缜辩因果
characters.en: Xiao Ziliang (萧子良) — royal / consort, Nanqi; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 王融
characters.zh: 王融（南齐·竟陵王西邸文士）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；劝范缜放弃其论，许以中书郎
characters.en: Wang Rong (王融) — scholar, Nanqi; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 萧衍
characters.zh: 萧衍（梁·西邸文士，后为梁武帝）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；即位后敕群臣驳难神灭论
characters.en: Xiao Yan (萧衍) — ruler, Liang; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 南齐永明年间，竟陵王萧子良在建康鸡笼山开西邸，招集天下文士，萧衍、沈约、王融等都在其中。萧子良笃信佛法，常请名僧讲经。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、烟、屋檐；主体：萧子良、众人｜动作：建康鸡笼山下的西邸，王公文士和名僧围坐，香烟缭绕｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；淡墨烟气横向飘散｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：诵经｜屏幕文字：片名「神灭论」竖排书法与朱印「神灭」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「南齐永明年间，竟陵王萧子良在建康鸡笼山开西邸，招集天下文士，萧衍、沈约、王融等都在其中。萧子良笃信佛法，常请名僧讲经。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–14 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, smoke, palace eaves; subject: Xiao Ziliang, crowd | Action: At the Western Residence below Jilong Hill princes, scholars and famous monks sit amid curling incense | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; pale ink smoke drifting sideways | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: chanting | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「神灭论」 with vermilion seal 「神灭」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「南齐永明年间，竟陵王萧子良在建康鸡笼山开西邸，招集天下文士，萧衍、沈约、王融等都在其中。萧子良笃信佛法，常请名僧讲经。」

shots.vo: 范缜也是西邸的宾客，却不信因果报应。萧子良问他：你不信因果，那世上为什么有富贵，有贫贱？
shots.zh: 镜头 2（14–25 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：萧子良、范缜｜动作：竟陵王问：你不信因果，那为什么有人富贵，有人贫贱？｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范缜也是西邸的宾客，却不信因果报应。萧子良问他：你不信因果，那世上为什么有富贵，有贫贱？」
shots.en: Shot 2 (14–25 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Xiao Ziliang, Fan Zhen | Action: The Prince of Jingling asks: if you deny karma, why are some born rich and others poor? | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「范缜也是西邸的宾客，却不信因果报应。萧子良问他：你不信因果，那世上为什么有富贵，有贫贱？」

shots.vo: 范缜说：人生就像一棵树上的花，同时开放，随风飘落，有的拂过帘幕落在席上，有的撞到篱笆掉进了粪坑。落在席上的是殿下，落进粪坑的是下官。贵贱虽然不同，因果又在哪里呢？
shots.zh: 镜头 3（25–43 秒，18 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、树、树冠；主体：范缜｜动作：范缜指着窗外：花开在一根枝上，风一吹，有的落在席子上，有的落进粪坑里｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：低风；音效：风声｜屏幕文字：引文「神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范缜说：人生就像一棵树上的花，同时开放，随风飘落，有的拂过帘幕落在席上，有的撞到篱笆掉进了粪坑。落在席上的是殿下，落进粪坑的是下官。贵贱虽然不同，因果又在哪里呢？」
shots.en: Shot 3 (25–43 s, 18 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, trees, tree canopy; subject: Fan Zhen | Action: Fan Zhen points out of the window: blossoms on one branch fall in the wind, some onto mats, some into the cesspit | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: wind | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「范缜说：人生就像一棵树上的花，同时开放，随风飘落，有的拂过帘幕落在席上，有的撞到篱笆掉进了粪坑。落在席上的是殿下，落进粪坑的是下官。贵贱虽然不同，因果又在哪里呢？」

shots.vo: 萧子良驳不倒他。王融去劝范缜：以你的才学，何愁当不上中书郎，何必固执此论？
shots.zh: 镜头 4（43–53 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：王融、范缜｜动作：王融私下来访，说只要放下这篇文章，中书郎的官位唾手可得｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「萧子良驳不倒他。王融去劝范缜：以你的才学，何愁当不上中书郎，何必固执此论？」
shots.en: Shot 4 (43–53 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Wang Rong, Fan Zhen | Action: Wang Rong calls in private: drop this essay and the post of Secretariat Gentleman is yours | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「萧子良驳不倒他。王融去劝范缜：以你的才学，何愁当不上中书郎，何必固执此论？」

shots.vo: 范缜大笑说：假如我范缜肯卖论取官，早就做到尚书令、仆射了，何止一个中书郎！他回去写了一篇文章——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（53–65 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：范缜；飞白题字「神灭」｜动作：范缜大笑，提笔写下：形存则神存，形谢则神灭｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范缜大笑说：假如我范缜肯卖论取官，早就做到尚书令、仆射了，何止一个中书郎！他回去写了一篇文章——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (53–65 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: Fan Zhen; dry-brush calligraphy 「神灭」 | Action: Fan Zhen laughs and writes: while the body lasts the spirit lasts; when the body perishes the spirit perishes | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「范缜大笑说：假如我范缜肯卖论取官，早就做到尚书令、仆射了，何止一个中书郎！他回去写了一篇文章——」

shots.vo: 范缜在《神灭论》里说，形体与精神的关系，就像刀刃与锋利：没有刀刃就没有锋利，没有形体，哪里还有精神？
shots.zh: 镜头 6（65–77 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：范缜｜动作：正史结局：范缜在《神灭论》里说，形体与精神的关系，就像刀刃与锋利：没有刀刃就没有锋利，没有形体，哪里还有精神？｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范缜在《神灭论》里说，形体与精神的关系，就像刀刃与锋利：没有刀刃就没有锋利，没有形体，哪里还有精神？」
shots.en: Shot 6 (65–77 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Fan Zhen | Action: Canonical outcome: Fan likens body and spirit to a blade and its sharpness; when Xiao Yan becomes Emperor Wu of Liang he orders over sixty nobles to refute the essay, and Fan still will not yield. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「范缜在《神灭论》里说，形体与精神的关系，就像刀刃与锋利：没有刀刃就没有锋利，没有形体，哪里还有精神？」

shots.vo: 神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（77–83 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。」，下署《梁书·儒林传·范缜，引《神灭论》》；右下角朱印「神灭」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (77–83 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。」 signed 《梁书·儒林传·范缜，引《神灭论》》; vermilion seal 「神灭」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、低风；音效：诵经、静默、风声、衣袂摩挲、笔落；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: quiet room tone, low wind; SFX: chanting, silence, wind, rustling silk, brush dropped; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

narration: 南齐永明年间，竟陵王萧子良在建康鸡笼山开西邸，招集天下文士，萧衍、沈约、王融等都在其中。萧子良笃信佛法，常请名僧讲经。
范缜也是西邸的宾客，却不信因果报应。萧子良问他：你不信因果，那世上为什么有富贵，有贫贱？
范缜说：人生就像一棵树上的花，同时开放，随风飘落，有的拂过帘幕落在席上，有的撞到篱笆掉进了粪坑。落在席上的是殿下，落进粪坑的是下官。贵贱虽然不同，因果又在哪里呢？
萧子良驳不倒他。王融去劝范缜：以你的才学，何愁当不上中书郎，何必固执此论？
范缜大笑说：假如我范缜肯卖论取官，早就做到尚书令、仆射了，何止一个中书郎！他回去写了一篇文章——
范缜在《神灭论》里说，形体与精神的关系，就像刀刃与锋利：没有刀刃就没有锋利，没有形体，哪里还有精神？
神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】南北朝 · 神灭论（范缜）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 83 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：南北朝 · 南齐武帝永明年间（约 489 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。

人物：
- 范缜（南齐·尚书殿中郎）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；著《神灭论》，主张形神相即
- 萧子良（南齐·竟陵王）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；宗室贵胄华服，玉佩冠带；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；崇信佛法，与范缜辩因果
- 王融（南齐·竟陵王西邸文士）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；劝范缜放弃其论，许以中书郎
- 萧衍（梁·西邸文士，后为梁武帝）：南朝褒衣博带；北朝裤褶、鲜卑帽；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；即位后敕群臣驳难神灭论

分镜：
镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、烟、屋檐；主体：萧子良、众人｜动作：建康鸡笼山下的西邸，王公文士和名僧围坐，香烟缭绕｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；淡墨烟气横向飘散｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：诵经｜屏幕文字：片名「神灭论」竖排书法与朱印「神灭」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「南齐永明年间，竟陵王萧子良在建康鸡笼山开西邸，招集天下文士，萧衍、沈约、王融等都在其中。萧子良笃信佛法，常请名僧讲经。」
镜头 2（14–25 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：萧子良、范缜｜动作：竟陵王问：你不信因果，那为什么有人富贵，有人贫贱？｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范缜也是西邸的宾客，却不信因果报应。萧子良问他：你不信因果，那世上为什么有富贵，有贫贱？」
镜头 3（25–43 秒，18 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、树、树冠；主体：范缜｜动作：范缜指着窗外：花开在一根枝上，风一吹，有的落在席子上，有的落进粪坑里｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：低风；音效：风声｜屏幕文字：引文「神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范缜说：人生就像一棵树上的花，同时开放，随风飘落，有的拂过帘幕落在席上，有的撞到篱笆掉进了粪坑。落在席上的是殿下，落进粪坑的是下官。贵贱虽然不同，因果又在哪里呢？」
镜头 4（43–53 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：王融、范缜｜动作：王融私下来访，说只要放下这篇文章，中书郎的官位唾手可得｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「萧子良驳不倒他。王融去劝范缜：以你的才学，何愁当不上中书郎，何必固执此论？」
镜头 5（53–65 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、书写、屋檐；主体：范缜；飞白题字「神灭」｜动作：范缜大笑，提笔写下：形存则神存，形谢则神灭｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范缜大笑说：假如我范缜肯卖论取官，早就做到尚书令、仆射了，何止一个中书郎！他回去写了一篇文章——」
镜头 6（65–77 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：范缜｜动作：正史结局：范缜在《神灭论》里说，形体与精神的关系，就像刀刃与锋利：没有刀刃就没有锋利，没有形体，哪里还有精神？｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「范缜在《神灭论》里说，形体与精神的关系，就像刀刃与锋利：没有刀刃就没有锋利，没有形体，哪里还有精神？」
镜头 7（77–83 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。」，下署《梁书·儒林传·范缜，引《神灭论》》；右下角朱印「神灭」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「神即形也，形即神也；是以形存则神存，形谢则神灭也。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、低风；音效：诵经、静默、风声、衣袂摩挲、笔落；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589) · On the Mortality of the Soul: Fan Zhen (「神灭论」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 83 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), c. 489 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

Characters:
- Fan Zhen (范缜) — scholar, Nanqi; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xiao Ziliang (萧子良) — royal / consort, Nanqi; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wang Rong (王融) — scholar, Nanqi; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xiao Yan (萧衍) — ruler, Liang; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Shot 2 (14–25 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Xiao Ziliang, Fan Zhen | Action: The Prince of Jingling asks: if you deny karma, why are some born rich and others poor? | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「范缜也是西邸的宾客，却不信因果报应。萧子良问他：你不信因果，那世上为什么有富贵，有贫贱？」

strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.title: 迁都洛阳
strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.subtitle: 北魏孝文帝
strings.vo.01: 北魏都于平城，地处北边，转运艰难。孝文帝欲迁都中原，又恐群臣不从。
strings.vo.02: 太和十七年，他以南伐为名，亲率步骑三十余万南下。
strings.vo.03: 大军行至洛阳，秋雨连绵不止，道路泥泞。
strings.vo.04: 孝文帝戎服执鞭，下令继续进军。群臣在马前叩首，请求停止南伐。
strings.vo.05: 他说：若不南伐，就迁都于此——
strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.fork.prompt: 迁都洛阳——依《魏书》直书，还是听演义《南北史演义》？
strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.pick.canon: 正史 · 《魏书》、《资治通鉴》所载
strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.canon.intro: 孝文帝想迁都，又怕群臣反对。他宣布：大举南伐。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.end.canon: 494 年正式迁都洛阳。496 年改拓跋氏为元氏。太子恂不愿南迁，被废。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.legend.disclaim: 以下参考蔡东藩《南北史演义》（本地文件名为“隋朝.pdf”）对迁都的敷演；原作已属公有领域，本作只作情节线索，不引用文字。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.legend.intro: 演义着力描写南征途中的君臣问答：孝文帝先与任城王元澄密议，再在朝会上故作盛怒，逼出众人真意。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.end.legend: 迁都之议已定。演义与正史同一结局。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.xiaowen.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若群臣不叩首（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 南北朝 · 北魏太和十七年至二十年（493—496 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。
setting.en: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 493 CE–496 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

characters.name: 北魏孝文帝
characters.zh: 北魏孝文帝（北魏·拓跋宏（元宏））：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；以南伐为名迁都洛阳，推行汉化
characters.en: Bei Weixiaowendi (北魏孝文帝) — ruler, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 北魏都于平城，地处北边，转运艰难。孝文帝欲迁都中原，又恐群臣不从。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–9 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：沙、城墙雉堞｜动作：平城，北地风沙｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；干笔擦出沙地；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：草原风｜屏幕文字：片名「迁都洛阳」竖排书法与朱印「迁都洛阳」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「北魏都于平城，地处北边，转运艰难。孝文帝欲迁都中原，又恐群臣不从。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sand, crenellated city wall | Action: Wind and sand of the north at Pingcheng | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; dry-brush scumbled sand; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: steppe wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「迁都洛阳」 with vermilion seal 「迁都洛阳」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北魏都于平城，地处北边，转运艰难。孝文帝欲迁都中原，又恐群臣不从。」

shots.vo: 太和十七年，他以南伐为名，亲率步骑三十余万南下。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（9–16 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：北魏孝文帝、骑兵、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：大军南下，名为伐齐｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「太和十七年，他以南伐为名，亲率步骑三十余万南下。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (9–16 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Bei Weixiaowendi, cavalry, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: The army marches south, ostensibly against Qi | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「太和十七年，他以南伐为名，亲率步骑三十余万南下。」

shots.vo: 大军行至洛阳，秋雨连绵不止，道路泥泞。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（16–22 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；飞白题字「雨」｜动作：洛阳，秋雨连绵｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；细密斜线笔触成雨｜声音：环境：大雨；音效：雨声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「大军行至洛阳，秋雨连绵不止，道路泥泞。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (16–22 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; dry-brush calligraphy 「雨」 | Action: Endless autumn rain at Luoyang | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; scorched-ink outline of battlements; fine slanted strokes for rain | Sound: ambience: heavy rain; SFX: rain | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「大军行至洛阳，秋雨连绵不止，道路泥泞。」

shots.vo: 孝文帝戎服执鞭，下令继续进军。群臣在马前叩首，请求停止南伐。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（22–30 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：鲜卑旧臣、北魏孝文帝、众人｜动作：群臣马前叩首｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入｜声音：环境：大雨；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孝文帝戎服执鞭，下令继续进军。群臣在马前叩首，请求停止南伐。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (22–30 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Xian Beijiuchen, Bei Weixiaowendi, crowd | Action: Ministers kowtow before his horse | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter | Sound: ambience: heavy rain; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孝文帝戎服执鞭，下令继续进军。群臣在马前叩首，请求停止南伐。」

shots.vo: 他说：若不南伐，就迁都于此——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（30–36 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：元；飞白题字「迁都」｜动作：改服易语｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他说：若不南伐，就迁都于此——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 元; dry-brush calligraphy 「迁都」 | Action: Changing dress and language | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他说：若不南伐，就迁都于此——」

shots.vo: 494 年正式迁都洛阳。496 年改拓跋氏为元氏。太子恂不愿南迁，被废。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（36–45 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：494 年正式迁都洛阳。496 年改拓跋氏为元氏。太子恂不愿南迁，被废。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「494 年正式迁都洛阳。496 年改拓跋氏为元氏。太子恂不愿南迁，被废。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (36–45 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The capital moves to Luoyang in 494; the royal clan takes the surname Yuan, and the crown prince who resisted is deposed. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「494 年正式迁都洛阳。496 年改拓跋氏为元氏。太子恂不愿南迁，被废。」

shots.zh: 镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「迁都洛阳」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处
shots.en: Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「迁都洛阳」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

sound.zh: 背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：草原风、大雨、战后余风；音效：马蹄声、雨声、低语、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, heavy rain, lingering wind after battle; SFX: hoofbeats, rain, murmuring, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「迁都洛阳」、副题「北魏孝文帝」、朱印「迁都洛阳」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「迁都洛阳」, subtitle 「北魏孝文帝」 and vermilion seal 「迁都洛阳」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 北魏都于平城，地处北边，转运艰难。孝文帝欲迁都中原，又恐群臣不从。
太和十七年，他以南伐为名，亲率步骑三十余万南下。
大军行至洛阳，秋雨连绵不止，道路泥泞。
孝文帝戎服执鞭，下令继续进军。群臣在马前叩首，请求停止南伐。
他说：若不南伐，就迁都于此——
494 年正式迁都洛阳。496 年改拓跋氏为元氏。太子恂不愿南迁，被废。

- 鲜卑旧臣（北魏·代北贵族）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；多不愿南迁
- 李冲（北魏·尚书）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；支持迁都，主持营建洛阳
- 拓跋恂（北魏·太子）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；不愿南迁，被废
- 冯太后（北魏·文明太后）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；孝文帝祖母，早年临朝，推行改革

分镜：
镜头 1（0–9 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：沙、城墙雉堞｜动作：平城，北地风沙｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；干笔擦出沙地；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：草原风｜屏幕文字：片名「迁都洛阳」竖排书法与朱印「迁都洛阳」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「北魏都于平城，地处北边，转运艰难。孝文帝欲迁都中原，又恐群臣不从。」
镜头 2（9–16 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：北魏孝文帝、骑兵、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：大军南下，名为伐齐｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「太和十七年，他以南伐为名，亲率步骑三十余万南下。」
镜头 3（16–22 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；飞白题字「雨」｜动作：洛阳，秋雨连绵｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；细密斜线笔触成雨｜声音：环境：大雨；音效：雨声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「大军行至洛阳，秋雨连绵不止，道路泥泞。」
镜头 4（22–30 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：鲜卑旧臣、北魏孝文帝、众人｜动作：群臣马前叩首｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入｜声音：环境：大雨；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孝文帝戎服执鞭，下令继续进军。群臣在马前叩首，请求停止南伐。」
镜头 5（30–36 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：元；飞白题字「迁都」｜动作：改服易语｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他说：若不南伐，就迁都于此——」
镜头 6（36–45 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：494 年正式迁都洛阳。496 年改拓跋氏为元氏。太子恂不愿南迁，被废。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「494 年正式迁都洛阳。496 年改拓跋氏为元氏。太子恂不愿南迁，被废。」
镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「迁都洛阳」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：草原风、大雨、战后余风；音效：马蹄声、雨声、低语、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「迁都洛阳」、副题「北魏孝文帝」、朱印「迁都洛阳」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589) · Moving the Capital to Luoyang: Emperor Xiaowen of Wei (「迁都洛阳」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 51 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 493 CE–496 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

Characters:
- Bei Weixiaowendi (北魏孝文帝) — ruler, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xian Beijiuchen (鲜卑旧臣) — minister, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Chong (李冲) — minister, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Tuoba Xun (拓跋恂) — royal / consort, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Empress Dowager Feng (冯太后) — royal / consort, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sand, crenellated city wall | Action: Wind and sand of the north at Pingcheng | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; dry-brush scumbled sand; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: steppe wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「迁都洛阳」 with vermilion seal 「迁都洛阳」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北魏都于平城，地处北边，转运艰难。孝文帝欲迁都中原，又恐群臣不从。」
Shot 2 (9–16 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Bei Weixiaowendi, cavalry, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: The army marches south, ostensibly against Qi | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「太和十七年，他以南伐为名，亲率步骑三十余万南下。」
Shot 3 (16–22 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; dry-brush calligraphy 「雨」 | Action: Endless autumn rain at Luoyang | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; scorched-ink outline of battlements; fine slanted strokes for rain | Sound: ambience: heavy rain; SFX: rain | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「大军行至洛阳，秋雨连绵不止，道路泥泞。」
Shot 4 (22–30 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Xian Beijiuchen, Bei Weixiaowendi, crowd | Action: Ministers kowtow before his horse | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter | Sound: ambience: heavy rain; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孝文帝戎服执鞭，下令继续进军。群臣在马前叩首，请求停止南伐。」
Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 元; dry-brush calligraphy 「迁都」 | Action: Changing dress and language | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他说：若不南伐，就迁都于此——」
Shot 6 (36–45 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The capital moves to Luoyang in 494; the royal clan takes the surname Yuan, and the crown prince who resisted is deposed. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「494 年正式迁都洛阳。496 年改拓跋氏为元氏。太子恂不愿南迁，被废。」
Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「迁都洛阳」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, heavy rain, lingering wind after battle; SFX: hoofbeats, rain, murmuring, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「迁都洛阳」, subtitle 「北魏孝文帝」 and vermilion seal 「迁都洛阳」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.title: 舍身同泰寺
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.subtitle: 梁武帝与达摩
strings.vo.01: 梁武帝晚年笃信佛教。大通元年三月，他驾临同泰寺，舍身为僧。三天后才回宫，大赦天下，改元大通。
strings.vo.02: 他造寺、写经、度僧，不可胜数，自己吃素，一日一食。后来又几次舍身，群臣每次都要拿出巨款把皇帝赎回来。
strings.vo.03: 同一时期的北方，洛阳永宁寺的九层浮屠高耸入云。北魏人杨衒之记下，有个叫菩提达摩的西域沙门，自称一百五十岁，见了这座塔，合掌赞叹多日。
strings.vo.04: 唐代的《续高僧传》又说，达摩在嵩洛一带传授“壁观”之法，有弟子慧可追随他。
strings.vo.05: 后来的禅宗书里，还说他曾见过梁武帝——
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.fork.prompt: 舍身同泰寺——依《梁书》直书，还是听禅宗传说「廓然无圣，一苇渡江」？
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《梁书·武帝纪》与《洛阳伽蓝记》《续高僧传》所载
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.canon.intro: 南方的皇帝舍身入寺，北方的胡僧面壁传法。两人是否真的见过，早期的史料里并没有记载。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.end.canon: 梁武帝回宫，改元大通。他一生四次舍身，最后在侯景之乱中饿死于台城。达摩的事迹，在唐宋禅宗典籍里越来越丰富。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.pick.legend: 禅宗传说 · 廓然无圣，一苇渡江
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.legend.disclaimer: 以下取北宋道原《景德传灯录》卷三：达摩于普通年间至广州，梁武帝迎至金陵，问“有何功德”，答“并无功德”；问“对朕者谁”，答“不识”；机缘不契，潜回江北，面壁九年。“一苇渡江”则是宋元以后的画题与传说。这些是禅宗典籍与民间传说，早期史料无载。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.legend.intro: 金陵宫中，皇帝问那个胡僧：朕即位以来，造寺写经度僧不可胜纪，有何功德？
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.end.legend: 一个舍身的皇帝，一个面壁的僧人。不论他们是否相见，梁朝的结局都已经写在了侯景之乱里。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.damo.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若梁武帝听懂了“并无功德”（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

shots.vo: 梁武帝晚年笃信佛教。大通元年三月，他驾临同泰寺，舍身为僧。三天后才回宫，大赦天下，改元大通。

narration: 梁武帝晚年笃信佛教。大通元年三月，他驾临同泰寺，舍身为僧。三天后才回宫，大赦天下，改元大通。
他造寺、写经、度僧，不可胜数，自己吃素，一日一食。后来又几次舍身，群臣每次都要拿出巨款把皇帝赎回来。
同一时期的北方，洛阳永宁寺的九层浮屠高耸入云。北魏人杨衒之记下，有个叫菩提达摩的西域沙门，自称一百五十岁，见了这座塔，合掌赞叹多日。
唐代的《续高僧传》又说，达摩在嵩洛一带传授“壁观”之法，有弟子慧可追随他。
后来的禅宗书里，还说他曾见过梁武帝——
梁武帝回宫，改元大通。他一生四次舍身，最后在侯景之乱中饿死于台城。达摩的事迹，在唐宋禅宗典籍里越来越丰富。
实是神功。

镜头 5（49–55 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：河水、舟；飞白题字「一苇」｜动作：江上，一根芦苇载着一个人北去｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：青铜钟声、风铃｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「后来的禅宗书里，还说他曾见过梁武帝——」
镜头 6（55–68 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：梁武帝回宫，改元大通。他一生四次舍身，最后在侯景之乱中饿死于台城。达摩的事迹，在唐宋禅宗典籍里越来越丰富。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「梁武帝回宫，改元大通。他一生四次舍身，最后在侯景之乱中饿死于台城。达摩的事迹，在唐宋禅宗典籍里越来越丰富。」
镜头 7（68–74 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「实是神功。」，下署《洛阳伽蓝记·卷一 城内·永宁寺》；右下角朱印「舍身」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「实是神功。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：青铜钟声、风铃、夜风、平缓河水；音效：衣袂摩挲、诵经、风铃、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「舍身同泰寺」、副题「梁武帝与达摩」、朱印「舍身」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「实是神功。」——《洛阳伽蓝记·卷一 城内·永宁寺》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589) · Giving Himself to Tongtai Temple: Emperor Wu of Liang and Bodhidharma (「舍身同泰寺」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 74 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 527 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

Characters:
- Xiao Yan (萧衍) — ruler, Liang; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Bodhidharma (菩提达摩) — scholar, Xiyu; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Shen Guang (神光（慧可）) — scholar, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Qun Chen (群臣) — minister, Liang; Southern court: loose robes with broad sashes, Northern: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hoods; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: The pagoda of Tongtai Temple towers north of Jiankang | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: bronze bell | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「舍身同泰寺」 with vermilion seal 「舍身」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「梁武帝晚年笃信佛教。大通元年三月，他驾临同泰寺，舍身为僧。三天后才回宫，大赦天下，改元大通。」
Shot 2 (11–23 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Xiao Yan | Action: The emperor removes his crown and puts on monk's robes | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: bronze bell; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他造寺、写经、度僧，不可胜数，自己吃素，一日一食。后来又几次舍身，群臣每次都要拿出巨款把皇帝赎回来。」
Shot 3 (23–39 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: clouds; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Bodhidharma | Action: At Yongning Temple in Luoyang a foreign monk praises the golden spire | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; clouds as moving pale wash | Sound: ambience: wind chimes; SFX: chanting | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「实是神功。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「同一时期的北方，洛阳永宁寺的九层浮屠高耸入云。北魏人杨衒之记下，有个叫菩提达摩的西域沙门，自称一百五十岁，见了这座塔，合掌赞叹多日。」
Shot 4 (39–49 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: rock silhouettes; subject: Bodhidharma; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: In a cave on Mount Song a man sits facing the wall | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: wind chimes | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「唐代的《续高僧传》又说，达摩在嵩洛一带传授“壁观”之法，有弟子慧可追随他。」
Shot 5 (49–55 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river, boat; dry-brush calligraphy 「一苇」 | Action: On the river a single reed carries a man north | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: bronze bell, wind chimes | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「后来的禅宗书里，还说他曾见过梁武帝——」
Shot 6 (55–68 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Emperor Wu returns to the palace; he gives himself to the temple four times and later starves in the Hou Jing rebellion. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「梁武帝回宫，改元大通。他一生四次舍身，最后在侯景之乱中饿死于台城。达摩的事迹，在唐宋禅宗典籍里越来越丰富。」
Shot 7 (68–74 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「实是神功。」 signed 《洛阳伽蓝记·卷一 城内·永宁寺》; vermilion seal 「舍身」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「实是神功。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: bronze bell, wind chimes, night wind, calm river; SFX: rustling silk, chanting, wind chimes, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「舍身同泰寺」, subtitle 「梁武帝与达摩」 and vermilion seal 「舍身」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「实是神功。」 — 《洛阳伽蓝记·卷一 城内·永宁寺》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.nanbeichao.lidaoyuan.title: 水经注
strings.scene.nanbeichao.lidaoyuan.subtitle: 郦道元之死
strings.vo.01: 古书《水经》只记了一百三十七条水道，文字简略。北魏的郦道元历任各地长官，每到一处，都要寻访河流的源头与流向，查考古迹和地名。
strings.vo.02: 他为《水经》作注，写成四十卷，记下了一千二百五十二条河流，以及沿岸的城邑、山川、古迹和传说，文字比原书多出二十倍。
strings.vo.03: 郦道元做官以严猛著称。任御史中尉时，他收捕了汝南王元悦的宠臣丘念，元悦请胡太后下诏赦免，郦道元抢先把丘念处死，又弹劾元悦。
strings.vo.04: 元悦怀恨在心，听说雍州刺史萧宝夤有反意，就怂恿朝廷派郦道元去关中做关右大使。萧宝夤果然派兵在阴盘驿把他包围了。
strings.vo.05: 驿亭在冈上，冈下才有水，叛军断了水路。郦道元和弟弟、儿子凿井十几丈也没有出水——
strings.scene.nanbeichao.lidaoyuan.quote: 遂为宝夤所害，死于阴盘驿亭。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.lidaoyuan.fork.prompt: 水经注——依《魏书》直书，还是听异文「水经注·江水」？
strings.anchor.zhushui: 郦道元历任地方官，遍访河川，为《水经》作注
strings.scene.nanbeichao.lidaoyuan.canon.intro: 一个人一辈子都在寻找河流的源头。他死的地方，是一座没有水的山冈。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.lidaoyuan.end.canon: 《北史》说，郦道元瞪着叛军厉声呵斥，与弟弟和两个儿子一起被杀。萧宝夤随即在长安称帝，不久兵败。郦道元留下的《水经注》，成了中国古代最重要的地理书之一。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.lidaoyuan.legend.discla: 以下取《水经注·江水》对三峡的描写：这段文字大半采自南朝宋盛弘之的《荆州记》，郦道元本人身在北朝，并没有到过三峡。文中所引“巴东三峡巫峡长”的渔者歌，是当地流传的民谣。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.lidaoyuan.legend.intro: 水经注里写道：自三峡七百里中，两岸连山，略无阙处。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.lidaoyuan.end.legend: 渔者唱道：巴东三峡巫峡长，猿鸣三声泪沾裳。一个从没去过三峡的北方人，把它写成了千古名篇。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 南北朝 · 北魏孝明帝孝昌三年（527 年）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。
setting.en: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 527 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

shots.vo: 古书《水经》只记了一百三十七条水道，文字简略。北魏的郦道元历任各地长官，每到一处，都要寻访河流的源头与流向，查考古迹和地名。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–15 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水；主体：郦道元、战马｜动作：黄河边，一个官员骑着马沿河而上，随从背着一捆捆竹简和地图｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：water-flow；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：片名「水经注」竖排书法与朱印「水经」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「古书《水经》只记了一百三十七条水道，文字简略。北魏的郦道元历任各地长官，每到一处，都要寻访河流的源头与流向，查考古迹和地名。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–15 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river; subject: Li Daoyuan, war horse | Action: By the Yellow River an official rides upstream, his attendants carrying bundles of bamboo slips and maps | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: water flow; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「水经注」 with vermilion seal 「水经」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「古书《水经》只记了一百三十七条水道，文字简略。北魏的郦道元历任各地长官，每到一处，都要寻访河流的源头与流向，查考古迹和地名。」

shots.vo: 他为《水经》作注，写成四十卷，记下了一千二百五十二条河流，以及沿岸的城邑、山川、古迹和传说，文字比原书多出二十倍。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（15–29 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：河水、近山与地面；主体：郦道元、众人｜动作：他在一条小河的源头蹲下，问一个放羊的老人这条水的旧名｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：water-flow；音效：water｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他为《水经》作注，写成四十卷，记下了一千二百五十二条河流，以及沿岸的城邑、山川、古迹和传说，文字比原书多出二十倍。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (15–29 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river, near hills and ground; subject: Li Daoyuan, crowd | Action: At the source of a stream he crouches and asks an old shepherd the water's ancient name | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: water flow; SFX: water | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他为《水经》作注，写成四十卷，记下了一千二百五十二条河流，以及沿岸的城邑、山川、古迹和传说，文字比原书多出二十倍。」

shots.vo: 郦道元做官以严猛著称。任御史中尉时，他收捕了汝南王元悦的宠臣丘念，元悦请胡太后下诏赦免，郦道元抢先把丘念处死，又弹劾元悦。

narration: 古书《水经》只记了一百三十七条水道，文字简略。北魏的郦道元历任各地长官，每到一处，都要寻访河流的源头与流向，查考古迹和地名。
他为《水经》作注，写成四十卷，记下了一千二百五十二条河流，以及沿岸的城邑、山川、古迹和传说，文字比原书多出二十倍。
郦道元做官以严猛著称。任御史中尉时，他收捕了汝南王元悦的宠臣丘念，元悦请胡太后下诏赦免，郦道元抢先把丘念处死，又弹劾元悦。
元悦怀恨在心，听说雍州刺史萧宝夤有反意，就怂恿朝廷派郦道元去关中做关右大使。萧宝夤果然派兵在阴盘驿把他包围了。
驿亭在冈上，冈下才有水，叛军断了水路。郦道元和弟弟、儿子凿井十几丈也没有出水——
《北史》说，郦道元瞪着叛军厉声呵斥，与弟弟和两个儿子一起被杀。萧宝夤随即在长安称帝，不久兵败。
遂为宝夤所害，死于阴盘驿亭。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589) · Commentary on the Waterways: The Death of Li Daoyuan (「水经注」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 86 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 527 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

Characters:
- Li Daoyuan (郦道元) — scholar, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xiao Baoyin (萧宝夤) — general, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yuan Yue (元悦) — royal / consort, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–15 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river; subject: Li Daoyuan, war horse | Action: By the Yellow River an official rides upstream, his attendants carrying bundles of bamboo slips and maps | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: water flow; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「水经注」 with vermilion seal 「水经」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「古书《水经》只记了一百三十七条水道，文字简略。北魏的郦道元历任各地长官，每到一处，都要寻访河流的源头与流向，查考古迹和地名。」
Shot 2 (15–29 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river, near hills and ground; subject: Li Daoyuan, crowd | Action: At the source of a stream he crouches and asks an old shepherd the water's ancient name | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: water flow; SFX: water | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他为《水经》作注，写成四十卷，记下了一千二百五十二条河流，以及沿岸的城邑、山川、古迹和传说，文字比原书多出二十倍。」
Shot 3 (29–44 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Li Daoyuan, Yuan Yue | Action: In the capital he seizes a prince's favourite and, as the prince begs the empress dowager for pardon, has the man killed first | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「遂为宝夤所害，死于阴盘驿亭。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「郦道元做官以严猛著称。任御史中尉时，他收捕了汝南王元悦的宠臣丘念，元悦请胡太后下诏赦免，郦道元抢先把丘念处死，又弹劾元悦。」
Shot 4 (44–58 s, 14 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: Xiao Baoyin, shield wall, army ranks, forest of spears, banners | Action: In Guanzhong the post station stands on a mound with its well below, and rebels ring the mound | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: high wind; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元悦怀恨在心，听说雍州刺史萧宝夤有反意，就怂恿朝廷派郦道元去关中做关右大使。萧宝夤果然派兵在阴盘驿把他包围了。」
Shot 5 (58–68 s, 10 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: Li Daoyuan, army ranks, forest of spears; dry-brush calligraphy 「水经」 | Action: Standing before the station he glares at the closing rebels and shouts them down | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: high wind; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「驿亭在冈上，冈下才有水，叛军断了水路。郦道元和弟弟、儿子凿井十几丈也没有出水——」
Shot 6 (68–80 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Li Daoyuan | Action: Canonical outcome: Li Daoyuan is killed with his brother and two sons; Xiao Baoyin proclaims himself emperor and soon falls, while the Commentary on the Waterways becomes one of China's great works of geography. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「《北史》说，郦道元瞪着叛军厉声呵斥，与弟弟和两个儿子一起被杀。萧宝夤随即在长安称帝，不久兵败。」
Shot 7 (80–86 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「遂为宝夤所害，死于阴盘驿亭。」 signed 《魏书·酷吏传·郦道元》; vermilion seal 「水经」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「遂为宝夤所害，死于阴盘驿亭。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: water flow, palace hall reverb, high wind; SFX: hoofbeats, water, ringing blade, war drums; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「水经注」, subtitle 「郦道元之死」 and vermilion seal 「水经」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「遂为宝夤所害，死于阴盘驿亭。」 — 《魏书·酷吏传·郦道元》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.nanbeichao.heyin.title: 河阴之变
strings.scene.nanbeichao.heyin.subtitle: 尔朱荣
strings.vo.01: 北魏末年，胡太后临朝，与孝明帝母子不和。武泰元年，孝明帝暴死，传说是被太后毒杀的。太后立了一个三岁的孩子元钊做皇帝。
strings.vo.02: 契胡酋长尔朱荣以为孝明帝报仇为名，从晋阳起兵南下，暗中迎立长乐王元子攸，元子攸从洛阳偷渡黄河，在他的大营即位，就是孝庄帝。
strings.vo.03: 洛阳城不战而降。胡太后剃度出家，被押到尔朱荣面前，再三哀求。尔朱荣拂衣而起。
strings.vo.04: 他下令把胡太后和幼主元钊沉进了黄河。
strings.vo.05: 几天后，尔朱荣以祭天为名，召集王公百官到河阴迎驾——
strings.scene.nanbeichao.heyin.fork.prompt: 河阴之变——依《魏书》直书，还是听笔记《洛阳伽蓝记》？
strings.anchor.zhenshi: 胡太后鸩杀孝明帝，立幼主元钊
strings.anchor.mingguang: 孝庄帝于明光殿手刃尔朱荣
strings.scene.nanbeichao.heyin.canon.intro: 一个契胡酋长打着为皇帝报仇的旗号进了洛阳。他请满朝的王公大臣到黄河边去迎驾。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.heyin.end.canon: 河阴一役，王公百官被杀一千多人，一说两千多人。北魏的朝廷几乎为之一空。两年后，孝庄帝在明光殿埋伏刺客，亲手刺杀了尔朱荣，自己不久也被尔朱氏所杀。北魏从此分裂为东魏和西魏。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.heyin.legend.disclaimer: 以下取东魏杨衒之《洛阳伽蓝记》：作者在北魏分裂后重访洛阳，城郭崩毁，寺院成墟。书中借永宁寺等寺院的兴废，追记了尔朱荣入洛、河阴之变以及洛阳的盛衰。属亲历者追忆，夹有不少灵异传闻。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.heyin.legend.intro: 杨衒之说，北魏最大的寺院永宁寺里有一座九层木塔，在一百里外都能看见。尔朱荣入洛，就把兵马驻在这座寺里。
strings.scene.nanbeichao.heyin.end.legend: 杨衒之说，永熙三年，永宁寺塔被雷火烧毁，火烧了三个月才熄灭，有人说海上曾看见这座塔的影子。这一年，北魏分裂了。

第 1 行：1. 尔朱荣（契胡酋长，大都督）（北魏·武将）；2. 胡太后（灵太后）（北魏·君主）。
第 2 行：3. 元子攸（北魏孝庄帝）（北魏·君主）；4. 元钊（三岁幼主）（北魏·宗室后妃）。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 南北朝 · 北魏孝庄帝建义元年（528 年五月）。佛寺石窟、建康与洛阳、草原与城塞。
setting.en: Northern and Southern dynasties (420–589), 528 CE — Buddhist temples and grottoes, Jiankang and Luoyang, steppe and frontier forts.

characters.name: 尔朱荣
characters.zh: 尔朱荣（北魏·契胡酋长，大都督）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；起兵入洛，沉胡太后，屠杀百官
characters.en: Er Zhurong (尔朱荣) — general, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.en: Empress Dowager Hu (胡太后) — ruler, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 元子攸
characters.zh: 元子攸（北魏·北魏孝庄帝）：北朝胡汉混融装束：裤褶、鲜卑帽或小冠；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；被尔朱荣拥立，后手刃尔朱荣
characters.en: Yuan Ziyou (元子攸) — ruler, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 元钊

characters.en: Yuan Zhao (元钊) — royal / consort, Beiwei; Northern-dynasty mixed dress: kuzhe trousers-and-jacket, Xianbei hood or small cap; a teenager; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 北魏末年，胡太后临朝，与孝明帝母子不和。武泰元年，孝明帝暴死，传说是被太后毒杀的。太后立了一个三岁的孩子元钊做皇帝。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；主体：尔朱荣、骑兵、旌旗｜动作：晋阳城外，契胡骑兵的黑旗遮住了半边天，要为死去的皇帝讨个说法｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：高处疾风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：片名「河阴之变」竖排书法与朱印「河阴」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「北魏末年，胡太后临朝，与孝明帝母子不和。武泰元年，孝明帝暴死，传说是被太后毒杀的。太后立了一个三岁的孩子元钊做皇帝。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–14 s, 14 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; subject: Er Zhurong, cavalry, banners | Action: Outside Jinyang the black banners of the Jie cavalry blot out half the sky, come to avenge the dead emperor | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: high wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「河阴之变」 with vermilion seal 「河阴」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「北魏末年，胡太后临朝，与孝明帝母子不和。武泰元年，孝明帝暴死，传说是被太后毒杀的。太后立了一个三岁的孩子元钊做皇帝。」

shots.vo: 契胡酋长尔朱荣以为孝明帝报仇为名，从晋阳起兵南下，暗中迎立长乐王元子攸，元子攸从洛阳偷渡黄河，在他的大营即位，就是孝庄帝。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（14–29 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：河水、舟、营帐；主体：元子攸｜动作：黄河渡口，新立的皇帝从洛阳偷偷渡河，来到尔朱荣的大营｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：tide；音效：waves｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「契胡酋长尔朱荣以为孝明帝报仇为名，从晋阳起兵南下，暗中迎立长乐王元子攸，元子攸从洛阳偷渡黄河，在他的大营即位，就是孝庄帝。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (14–29 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river, boat, army tents; subject: Yuan Ziyou | Action: At a Yellow River ferry the newly chosen emperor slips across from Luoyang to Erzhu Rong's camp | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: tide; SFX: waves | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「契胡酋长尔朱荣以为孝明帝报仇为名，从晋阳起兵南下，暗中迎立长乐王元子攸，元子攸从洛阳偷渡黄河，在他的大营即位，就是孝庄帝。」

shots.vo: 洛阳城不战而降。胡太后剃度出家，被押到尔朱荣面前，再三哀求。尔朱荣拂衣而起。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（29–39 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：河水；主体：胡太后、尔朱荣、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：太后剃了头发，跪在马前哀求，尔朱荣拂袖而起｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：tide；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：引文「河阴之下，衣冠涂地。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「洛阳城不战而降。胡太后剃度出家，被押到尔朱荣面前，再三哀求。尔朱荣拂衣而起。」

narration: 北魏末年，胡太后临朝，与孝明帝母子不和。武泰元年，孝明帝暴死，传说是被太后毒杀的。太后立了一个三岁的孩子元钊做皇帝。
契胡酋长尔朱荣以为孝明帝报仇为名，从晋阳起兵南下，暗中迎立长乐王元子攸，元子攸从洛阳偷渡黄河，在他的大营即位，就是孝庄帝。
洛阳城不战而降。胡太后剃度出家，被押到尔朱荣面前，再三哀求。尔朱荣拂衣而起。
他下令把胡太后和幼主元钊沉进了黄河。
几天后，尔朱荣以祭天为名，召集王公百官到河阴迎驾——
河阴一役，王公百官被杀一千多人，一说两千多人。北魏的朝廷几乎为之一空。
河阴之下，衣冠涂地。
